name: ax-erp360
description: AX-ERP360 — plateforme ERP nouvelle génération d’AXORA GROUP SARLU

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @ax-erp360/types build && pnpm --filter @ax-erp360/validation build && pnpm --filter @ax-erp360/security build && pnpm --filter @ax-erp360/database build && pnpm --filter @ax-erp360/domain build && pnpm --filter @ax-erp360/ui build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r lint
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm db:format:check && pnpm db:validate && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
